fusions.name: Footboard Pounce
fusions.desc: Springs you from your seat onto a target up to 6 tiles away. The pounce deals 14 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Passing Rake
fusions.desc: Rakes claws across a cone 2 tiles long as you go by. It deals 3 damage, with a 25% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Righting Reflex
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Weaving Traffic
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack faster for each stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
